note: Fessenden city park campground on Highway 15 beside a small park, near the grain elevator and the rail line: back-in gravel sites with hookups, restrooms and showers. Train and grain-elevator noise at night. The city's website is unpublished; the rate is camper-reported ($15 a night, May 2026), and that camper found the electric sites taken by construction workers and parked in the lot. --Claude
summary: No live operator page (city sites down/unpublished; ND Tourism refuses). Camper reports: $15 (May 2026, written as reported), gravel back-in FHU sites, restrooms/showers, train noise; May 2026 the electric sites were occupied by construction workers. Directory-derived max_rig_ft 30 cleared (33-ft trailer reported fitting). Hookups/count/showers/year-round left derived. Sites not identifiable on imagery; pin left.
